content: Patients diagnosed with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) or those identified as being at high cardiovascular risk, who also present with moderately elevated triglyceride levels, should consider incorporating icosapent ethyl into their treatment regimen. This therapy should be used as an adjunct to established lifestyle modifications, such as dietary changes and physical activity, as well as standard lipid-lowering medications. The addition of icosapent ethyl aims to provide further reduction in cardiovascular risk beyond what is achieved with lifestyle and lipid-lowering therapies alone.
